scope: A1+A2 consolidated lifecycle audit and measured file-vs-SQLite architectural comparison (CPU-only, read-only host, evidence-only)

host.storage_class: NVMe btrfs root; synthetic comparator runs on os.tmpdir() = tmpfs (RAM-backed), not the NVMe root

host_inventory.queue: 4000/4000 full; 0 actionable; states approved=3117 deferred=862 skipped=21
host_inventory.reviews: 565 files; persisted=355 (all UUID+index valid), deferred=205, skipped=5

benchmark_summary.note: synthetic single-process screening on tmpfs; not multi-process durable equivalence

F_file_archive.summary: Split bounded actionable pending from a durable, source-preserving, addressable archive. Keep original source JSON and exact event IDs.
F_file_archive.evidence_fit: Host inventory is a clean, low-ambiguity archival case: queue 4000/4000 full, 0 actionable, 4000 archivable candidates, 0 ambiguous/cross-origin/wrong-scope/unowned, 355/355 persisted reviews UUID+index valid. The capacity problem is entirely 'settled sources occupy slots'. Synthetic screen: archive_json frees capacity (0 burst drops vs 1000/2000 for retained_json).
F_file_archive.cost_loc: small: an archive directory + a bounded 'move settled source to archive' transition; consumers keep reading the same JSON layout.
F_file_archive.rollback: reversible (rename back); source-preserving, no data loss.
F_file_archive.crash: weakest point is rename-not-fsync'd archival (crash mid-move can leave a file in pending OR history) - bounded and governed by the F rule 'crash after review CAS but before archive must converge'; duplicate-after-archival is a duplicate (confirmed by both comparators).
F_file_archive.migration_risk: low - additive, no schema, no all-consumer migration, no competing mirror.

S_single_sqlite.summary: One transactional SQLite evidence/work ledger with unique source IDs, fact ownership and exact remote UUID/index; must replace redundant JSON review/queue authorities, not become a permanent competing mirror. Prototype is deliberately NOT production schema/migration code.
S_single_sqlite.evidence_fit: Adds transactional crash safety (rollback_preserves_active=true) and ~20-33% faster p50 admission at scale (2.78 vs 3.49 @4000; 2.87 vs 4.25 @8000).
S_single_sqlite.cost_loc: new production schema + migration + migrating ALL consumers (queue, review, episode-index, EX gate, portal, recall) into one ledger; ~2x storage bytes (1.97MB vs 0.995MB @4000; 3.95MB vs 1.99MB @8000).
S_single_sqlite.justified_when: scans/joins/cross-file crash boundaries materially defeat F. Current host data shows no such pathology (clean single-origin, 0 index misses/bad, no corruption), so S's added cost is not yet justified by the evidence.

recommendation.rationale: Measured bounded active work (0 actionable) plus a source-preserving archive solves the observed capacity saturation (queue_full 5949 historical drops) with materially lower operational complexity and migration risk than a full SQLite ledger migration. S is retained as the justified alternative if Central later wants transactional crash atomicity and accepts migrating all consumers. Final A3 choice is Central's; this is A1/A2 evidence only, not final migration/production acceptance.
recommendation.quarantine_or_central_decision: All 4000 production sources are archivable candidates requiring Central authorization to archive (A3). 0 sources require quarantine (0 ambiguous, 0 cross-origin, 0 wrong-scope, 0 unowned, 0 missing/bad index).

a3_invariants: Archive only sources with authenticated durable review ownership (owned, single-origin, right-scope, non-actionable).
Split bounded actionable pending from the source-preserving archive; never delete evidence to gain capacity.
Crash after review CAS but before archive must converge (idempotent; no orphan, no double-count).
Duplicate submission of an archived source remains a duplicate.
Anomalous retained events must not be silently orphaned, deleted, or converted to terminal.
Preserve revision CAS, no-replay, EX, and rollback through any migration.
omission_log: Home paths (/home/...) and the full curator.env / unit definition are omitted from published files; the installed contract is described functionally (group, EX wrapper role, curator CLI role, loopback endpoint port 8766) with no secrets or full config dumps.

Live Graphiti group/index count was NOT performed (live_graphiti_checked=false) to keep the campaign CPU-only and strictly read-only; the local _episode-index readback (355 valid / 0 missing / 0 bad) is the terminal-scope corroboration.
No add_memory, model inference, Graphiti replay, schema conversion, service restart, or production mutation was performed.
Benchmarks are synthetic single-process screening on tmpfs, not multi-process durable equivalence (per comparator limitations).

installed_contract_short.curator_unit: ghdev-curator-prod.service (oneshot event-wake; observed activating/auto-restart exit-code, not mutated)
